notes: Stories created for Provider Quality Snapshot feature using existing NPI service.

change_log.value: Added schema/contract story for provider quality snapshot
Added core logic mapping from NPI data
Added API exposure via EvaluateCare facade

EVAL-PROVIDER-QUALITY-S1.title: Define Provider Quality Snapshot Schema and Contract
EVAL-PROVIDER-QUALITY-S1.description: Define a structured schema for provider quality snapshot including credential, specialty, license state, status, enumeration date, and address fields sourced from NPI data.

EVAL-PROVIDER-QUALITY-S2.title: Implement Provider Quality Mapping Logic from NPI डेटा
EVAL-PROVIDER-QUALITY-S2.description: Extract and normalize NPI registry fields from provider_detail_service into the defined snapshot schema, handling missing or inconsistent values.

EVAL-PROVIDER-QUALITY-S3.title: Expose Provider Quality Snapshot via EvaluateCare Facade
EVAL-PROVIDER-QUALITY-S3.description: Extend evaluate_care_facade to include provider quality snapshot in provider detail responses for downstream consumption.

EVAL-PROVIDER-QUALITY-S4.title: Render Provider Quality Snapshot in Chat UI
EVAL-PROVIDER-QUALITY-S4.description: Display provider quality snapshot fields in the frontend chat interface using structured formatting within MessageBubble or equivalent component.

EVAL-PROVIDER-QUALITY-S5.title: Unit and Integration Tests for Provider Quality Snapshot
EVAL-PROVIDER-QUALITY-S5.description: Create unit tests for mapping logic and integration tests validating end-to-end flow from NPI service through facade to API response.

EVAL-PROVIDER-QUALITY.mitigation: Fallback to partial snapshot display when NPI fields are missing
